title: Enhancing Diagnostic Accuracy through Multi-Agent Conversations: Using Large Language Models to Mitigate Cognitive Bias

defines.name: LLM-driven multi-agent conversation framework
defines.definition: A GPT-4-based multi-agent simulation that models clinical team discussion with specialized roles to reduce cognitive bias and improve diagnostic accuracy.

problem: Cognitive biases in clinical decision-making can cause misdiagnosis, and existing approaches have not sufficiently mitigated these errors in challenging cases.
